description: A shirtless, dark-skinned man in a loincloth climbs a rock cliff on hanging ropes and reaches toward a large golden honeycomb, with honey dripping down the rock and a swarm of bees around him. A woven basket hangs at his hip. Firelight glows at the lower left, and vines and ropes hang along a narrow canyon. There is no lettering and no frame, and the painting fills the image edge to edge. A small sparkle logo sits in the bottom-right corner, which is allowed.
reason: Shows a man gathering honey from a cliff, but the card is Jackie Robinson's 1947 debut for the Brooklyn Dodgers. Nothing in the picture is baseball or mid-20th-century, and the loincloth and rope-and-basket setting do not fit 1947 America.
